Section: Meridian pilot notes: Thursday 29 October 2026

Written by: Karan Malhotra

First weekly status call held at 4 PM. Neha's team sent the invite, so the open question from Tuesday is closed.Meera found a column in Meridian's sample file that is not in the specification: remitter VPA. Meridian confirmed it is optional. Decision: the field is mapped as optional and will not block ingestion.Meridian legal signed the NDA late in the evening.Riya started preparing the SOC 2 report package for Vikram Rao. Under our process the report goes out within 3 business days of a signed NDA.Questionnaire work: the team is answering from the policy documents and will send it by the due date, Fri 6 Nov.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Document: Meridian pilot notes, Wed 28 Oct 2026
Section: Meridian pilot notes: Wednesday 28 October 2026

Written by: Karan Malhotra

Riya sent the mutual NDA to Neha a week early. Meridian legal is reviewing it.Sanjay Desai named the two UAT analysts: Pooja Menon and Imran Qureshi. This is ahead of the 13 Nov date.Meera's first mapping draft covers 18 of the roughly 40 columns.Arjun's first anonymised sample file failed validation in the sandbox. Cause: dates were written as DD-MM-YYYY, and the sandbox expects ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Arjun asked for AWS production access to debug it. Declined, because interns are not eligible. Karan pulled the sandbox logs for him instead and Arjun fixed the date format.Base sandbox environment is up. API credentials not yet issued.
